episode_summaries.summary: Worf leads Chekov to the airlock on Fleet Admiral's orders. Kirk commands Worf to stand down — refused. Worf claims the order was signed personally by the Fleet Admiral. Kirk and Worf watch the airlock seal. Chekov screams it's a setup from behind the glass. Kirk stares at the sealed door and asks: 'Worf. Who really gave you that order.' Worf drops his eyes. Silence.
episode_summaries.cliffhanger: Worf knows who really gave the order — and it wasn't the Fleet Admiral
